data.one_liner: A Flutter widget providing a masked text field for formatting user input.
data.what_it_does: Provides a text field widget that automatically formats input according to a specified mask (such as for phone numbers, dates, or IP addresses). Allows custom escape characters and change callbacks.
use_when: You need to format user input like phone numbers, dates, or IP addresses using a custom mask.
You want a simple input masking solution integrated directly into a text field widget.
avoid_when: You require complex pin code entry workflows with individual boxes.
You need advanced validation rules outside of basic text masking.
strengths: Simple and straightforward setup with customizable escape characters.
Supports multiple input types and common formatting patterns out of the box.
weaknesses: Very minimal documentation and changelog details.

alternatives.name: pinput
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a specialized and customizable pin code input field instead of general text masking.

alternatives.name: pin_code_fields
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you are building OTP or pin code forms with dedicated box UI elements.

data.minimal_example:
MaskedTextField(
    textFieldController: ipController,
    inputDecoration: const InputDecoration(
        hintText: '192.192.192.192',
        counterText: ""
    ),
    mask: 'xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx',
    maxLength: 15,
    keyboardType: TextInputType.number,
)
